scope: Gameplay water during an unpopulated 60-game-minute run; not a geographic safe class, pumping or long-term promise. Chosen after all five reference results and BEFORE any new-constructor native result.
retention_definition: Same >0.1m/<=64m nearby-water predicate. Aggregate ALL original natural-point occurrences, not any failed sector causing whole-map failure. Original per-sector outcomes stay unchanged.
body_definition: All pre-native authored wet native nodes; >=7q/<=64m. Check each component >=54 nodes; this is the predeclared construction body-size policy, not a learned safe class. Every original geographic point remains in the aggregate.
surface_definition: Maximum across captures of the 95th percentile absolute change from t0 among paired positive-depth/wet API samples. Dry/missing remain separate; this is not prescribed boundary stage or flow. Tolerance is twice the largest observed stock movement, rounded UP to whole metres.
exclusion_reason: All three stock maps hit missing image-review/authored-camera expectations too. Raw checks and screenshots remain; these are not water failures.
